articles.summary: ORLANDO, Fla., Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Nutriband Inc. (NASDAQ:NTRB), announced today that it has seen 272,671 NTRBW warrants exercised at a strike price of $6.43 for proceeds to the company of $1,753,274.53. NTRBW warrants expired on September 30 with no extension. The Company has no remaining tradeable warrants.The primary use of proceeds will be used towards the remaining clinical development of AVERSA Fentanyl and submission of its NDA with the FDA for marketing approval.
